sentences.text: Mother Teresa , known in the Catholic Church as Saint Teresa of Calcutta -LRB- born Anjezë Gonxhe Bojaxhiu ; -LSB- aˈɲɛzə ˈɡɔndʒɛ bɔjaˈdʒiu -RSB- ; 26 August 1910 -- 5 September 1997 -RRB- , was an Albanian-Indian Roman Catholic nun and missionary .	Calcutta	Calcutta	Albanian	Albanians	Roman Catholic	Catholic Church	nun	nun	missionary	missionary

She was born in Skopje -LRB- now the capital of the Republic of Macedonia -RRB- , then part of the Kosovo Vilayet of the Ottoman Empire .	Kosovo Vilayet	Kosovo Vilayet	Ottoman Empire	Ottoman Empire	Skopje	Skopje	Republic of Macedonia	Republic of Macedonia
After living in Macedonia for eighteen years she moved to Ireland and then to India , where she lived for most of her life .	India	India

In 1950 Teresa founded the Missionaries of Charity , a Roman Catholic religious congregation which had over 4,500 sisters and was active in 133 countries in 2012 .	Missionaries of Charity	Missionaries of Charity	Roman Catholic	Catholic Church	religious congregation	Congregation (Catholic)

The congregation manages homes for people dying of HIV/AIDS , leprosy and tuberculosis ; soup kitchens ; dispensaries and mobile clinics ; children 's - and family-counselling programmes ; orphanages , and schools .	HIV/AIDS	HIV/AIDS	leprosy	leprosy	tuberculosis	tuberculosis
Members , who take vows of chastity , poverty , and obedience , also profess a fourth vow : to give `` wholehearted free service to the poorest of the poor '' .

Teresa received a number of honours , including the 1962 Ramon Magsaysay Peace Prize and 1979 Nobel Peace Prize .	Ramon Magsaysay Peace Prize	List of Ramon Magsaysay Award winners	Nobel Peace Prize	Nobel Peace Prize

She was canonised -LRB- recognised by the church as a saint -RRB- on 4 September 2016 , and the anniversary of her death -LRB- 5 September -RRB- is her feast day .	canonised	Canonization	saint	saint	feast day	feast day
A controversial figure during her life and after her death , Teresa was admired by many for her charitable work .	during her life and after her death	Criticism of Mother Teresa
She was praised and criticised for her opposition to abortion , and criticised for poor conditions in her houses for the dying .	opposition to abortion	Anti-abortion movements

Her authorised biography was written by Navin Chawla and published in 1992 , and she has been the subject of films and other books .	Navin Chawla	Navin Chawla	films and other books	#Film and literature
